title: BANANA-TO-JANUS-CAUSALITY-BRIDGE
purpose: Link the January 2026 banana-as-code metaphor with reproducibility and prospective-causality safeguards of JANUS Ocean's QPU-005, without conflating conceptual analogy with biological, computational, or retrocausal evidence.

original_sources.commit_vs_embedded_timestamp_note: Two different timestamps are preserved; the embedded JSON timestamp is not independently treated as a verified event time.
key_literals: Biological Organisms are Legacy Systems running on Liquid Servers.

interpretation.central_analogy: Treat a living system as a versioned, measurable process; treat a quantum experiment as a versioned, measurable physical protocol. Versioning, provenance and controls can be reused as engineering methods; the underlying systems are not computationally or physically equivalent.
interpretation.biological_status: Banana ripening is a biochemical, forward-causal process influenced by ethylene, maturity and environmental conditions. The early Unicode substitutions in the JSON are presentation glyphs, not nucleotide decoding, genomic sequencing or evidence of an executable computer program.
interpretation.quantum_status: The scheduled order of A measurement then ancilla C choice then B measurement is encoded in QPU-005, but independent shot-level times, spacelike choice, free-choice isolation and a future-to-past channel are not demonstrated.

concept_to_protocol_map.janus_concept: immutable preregistration and frozen analysis plan
concept_to_protocol_map.actionable_rule: Reference original commit, file hashes and frozen criteria; append new revisions instead of silently rewriting old records.

concept_to_protocol_map.janus_concept: Qiskit circuit build and backend transpilation
concept_to_protocol_map.actionable_rule: Keep source circuit separate from compiled ISA/QPY; hash and archive compiled artifacts and backend metadata.
Record experimental variants and changed gates before any new measurements; original 005 outcome stays bound to its preregistered plan.

concept_to_protocol_map.janus_concept: common-mode hardware noise and need for independent replication
concept_to_protocol_map.actionable_rule: Do not count multiple jobs on one backend as independent laboratories; predeclare controls for drift, crosstalk and device variation.
Freeze forecasts from earlier observations and compare them with later observed ripening, with timestamps and a baseline; expected forecasting skill is not retrocausality.

proposed_controls.objective: Show that JANUS Ocean can distinguish ordinary predictive relationships from leakage or later-information contamination.
proposed_controls.input: Prospectively collected time-stamped non-sensitive plant/environment/ripening observations; not supplied by this JSON.
proposed_controls.frozen_before_future: Training cutoff, model checksum, preprocessing code, output predictions, collection schedule and leakage audit.
proposed_controls.baseline: Last-value, maturation-stage-only, or other predeclared simple prospective forecaster.
measures: Prospective calibration and proper scoring rule
negative_controls: Randomized later labels evaluated as a diagnostic
proposed_controls.interpretation_limit: Positive predictive accuracy can arise entirely from ordinary forward-time causation.

proposed_controls.objective: Audit unconditioned early outcome versus later ancilla setting without postselection.
proposed_controls.primary_endpoint: Full-shot raw 2x2 A-versus-C table, two-sided Fisher exact test at preregistered nominal alpha=0.001.
controls: No selection by later B measurement
Preserve entire shot stream and provider job ID
Record compiled circuit SHA, backend identification, drift/timing uncertainties
Separate device diagnostics from primary endpoint
proposed_controls.interpretation_limit: A significant p-value on one device cannot alone identify retrocausality or exclude conventional hardware explanations.

proposed_controls.objective: Test whether every assertion points to its correct historical revision and measurement class.
checks: Distinct SHA references for January original vs later banana annotation
QPU-005 preregistration left byte-identical and unchanged
No mock or simulator measurement is promoted as hardware
No hidden after-the-fact selection of observations or models

levels.label: REPRODUCIBLE_SOFTWARE
levels.requirement: Versioned sources, deterministic offline checks and provenance

levels.label: OBSERVED_DATA
levels.requirement: Independent measurements with intact original records and timestamps

levels.label: CAUSAL_INFERENCE
levels.requirement: Predeclared experimental design, controls, sufficient power and exclusion of alternatives

levels.label: INDEPENDENT_PHYSICAL_REPLICATION
levels.requirement: Independent custodian and distinct apparatus with verified causal separation

permitted_statements: The January 2026 banana note contains a biological-computation metaphor and a ripening process sketch.
Its historical file and later annotated version can serve as traceability fixtures.
The same engineering ideas of versioning, tests and failure boundaries can strengthen JANUS Ocean protocols.
prohibited_claims: Banana DNA has been actually decoded into Unicode executable code.
The banana-as-code analogy proves that reality is a computer simulation.
Ripening predicts future random quantum choices by retrocausality.
IBM QPU-005 has produced physical evidence of backwards-in-time communication.
An observed correlation without leakage and hardware controls proves retrocausality.
next_gate: Run source-link/hash and JSON-schema validation as a read-only CI; thereafter consider a separate explicitly preregistered control-data study. Never merge conceptual control outcomes with real QPU measurements.
